visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with an extreme close-up of a golden-brown, sesame-encrusted pepper meat pie being split open by two hands, revealing a steaming, juicy interior filled with minced meat and scallions. (2) The scene shifts to a top-down view of a glass bowl where a person wearing transparent plastic gloves is preparing a meat mixture with raw minced pork, chopped onions, and garlic on a wooden tabletop. (3) Various seasonings, including salt, white pepper, black pepper, sesame oil, and rice wine, are sprinkled onto the meat, with white text overlays indicating the exact measurements. (4) The hands mix the meat and seasonings thoroughly until the texture is uniform, then soy sauce is added from a bottle to darken the mixture before a second round of mixing. (5) A flat, round piece of dough is placed on a brown silicone baking mat with circular patterns; the person scoops a large portion of the meat filling onto the center and adds a heap of fresh green scallions on top. (6) The chef carefully pleats and pinches the edges of the dough to seal the bun, rotating it in their hands to create a neat top similar to a traditional soup dumpling. (7) A small bowl containing a honey-water mixture is shown; a pastry brush is dipped in and used to coat the tops of the assembled buns to create a sticky surface. (8) Each bun is pressed top-down into a plate of white sesame seeds, ensuring a thick, even coating of seeds on the upper surface. (9) The buns are placed on a tray and slid into a preheated oven with orange-glowing heating elements; text overlays specify the temperature at 200°C and a baking time of 20-25 minutes. (10) The final shot returns to the close-up of the piping hot, baked pepper pie being broken apart, showing the flaky crust and savory meat juices.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A friendly male voice begins narrating the recipe over a cheerful acoustic guitar and piano BGM track. (2) A subtle wet 'thud' sound is heard as the meat is placed in the bowl, accompanied by the narrator explaining the pork ratios. (3) Faint metallic clinks occur as seasonings are added, while the BGM remains steady in tempo. (4) A distinctive 'squish' texture from the gloved hands mixing the meat is audible under the narration. (5) A 'splash' sound of soy sauce hitting the bowl triggers a new phase of mixing instructions. (6) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect acts as a transitional marker as the video cuts to the assembly phase. (7) The rustle of plastic gloves and the sound of dough being manipulated are heard during the pleating process. (8) A soft friction sound of bristles brushing honey water onto the dough occurs, followed by the crisp rustle of sesame seeds. (9) A heavy mechanical 'click' and 'clunk' signal the oven door opening and closing. (10) The video concludes with the loud, satisfying 'crunch' of the crust as the pie is broken, paired with high-arousal closing remarks.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a high-production-value instructional tutorial for making Taiwanese-style pepper pies (Hujiao Bing) at home. It leverages 'ASMR-like' visual and audio cues—such as the sound of the crust breaking and the visual of the steam—to stimulate the viewer's appetite and encourage them to follow the provided recipe.
